subject.title: [codex] fix(sessions): report archive cleanup in sessions cleanup

question: Should `sessions cleanup` use the existing archive-retention rules to report and remove stale `.deleted.*` and `.reset.*` transcript archives during dry-run/apply cleanup?
rationale: The code path is technically coherent, but physical transcript archive cleanup is session-state and retention-policy sensitive, so automation should not decide that merge risk by itself.

options.title: Accept retention cleanup
options.body: Accept that stale deleted/reset archives are removable under existing retention settings, then refresh and land after exact-head checks.

options.title: Pause for archive policy
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want a broader no-delete or renamed archive contract before adding stronger cleanup reporting.

recommendation.title: Accept retention cleanup
recommendation.body: Accept that stale deleted/reset archives are removable under existing retention settings, then refresh and land after exact-head checks.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the affected cleanup CLI and are the strongest available owner for the user-facing cleanup behavior.
